legacy_dependency_policy: LB-02 and LB-03 fixed-member product/pose screens are historical evidence, not prerequisites to the owner-authorized hidden-frame redesign. Active G1 work is HF-00 through HF-03; substantive v2 criteria, six-case analysis, shop package and independent review remain required.
latest_center_screens: The full-center HL33 tongue is nominal geometry only. A seven-axis wood screen finds negative conditional reversible 4D/7D margins, with load-dependent NDS categories and shaped boundaries unresolved. Rearward thickening of all six cut rails to a nominal 4x6 section retains fixed panel-screw receivers but collides at both bottom rails with the header and upper HL33 seats; that rail pose is rejected. Neither result closes G1 or releases drilling. See hardware_first_center_tongue_wood.md and hardware_first_center_thick_rails.md.
latest_rail_relief_screen: Profiled one-piece 4x6 bottom rails remove only added rear wood around header and upper seats; nominal CAD clashes clear and full-thickness rail-side bands remain. No factory bracket or mating seat, bolt group, access or resistance is established. The shared-post stack screen rejects 8-in nominal length with two washers and full nut; longer A307-listed dimensional leads lack explicit Grade A subtype. Both are conditional development evidence, not G1 closure. See hardware_first_center_rail_relief.md and hardware_first_center_post_stack.md.
latest_upper_pair_and_rail_bracket_scree: The same-Y opposing upper HL33 pair is rejected by seat-seat overlap and opposite-principal penetration. Outward translation of unchanged rectangular principals sufficient to separate seats loses fixed center panel screw axes. A bounded exact-retail A66/HL33/UB66 rail bracket shortlist finds no demonstrated all-six installed fit and ordinary-duration resistance. This does not reject every alternative factory-bracket pose. See hardware_first_center_upper_pair.md and rail-factory-bracket-shortlist.md.
latest_upper_stagger_screen: Rearward shifts of both inward upper HL33 brackets by 63.5, 66 and 70 mm retain seat-seat and opposite-principal collisions and lose bore receiving wood at the oblique toes. These sampled poses are rejected; no continuous search or all-bracket verdict. See hardware_first_center_upper_stagger.md.
latest_load_axis_screen: Corrected against Simpson C-C-2026 p.315 typical installation: HL F1 follows horizontal flange reach, perpendicular to the bend. For outward-X HL33, local F1 maps to global X; global Y is the unlisted transverse action. The prior Y/F1 mapping was rotated by 90 degrees. Paired HLs do not create unlisted Y or moment capacity. MiTek B66 publishes F2 but only at C_D=1.6. Current-geometry simultaneous demand and ordinary-duration resistance remain unresolved. See hl-load-axis-audit.md and hl_load_axes.py.
latest_hl_connected_screens: Two 45/65-mm rear-extension HL33 common-core poses preserve all 66 screw receivers and disjoint wood solids but reject: the shared backing bolt crosses only 50.8 mm of core tongue against the 88.9-mm catalog minimum, uses an unlisted three-wood/two-angle stack, and has blocked bolt-end/tool access; all six rail connections remain open. HL53 separated-rib poses at 480/520/560-mm spacing reject bracket-body/neighbor conflicts; a 520-mm bottom-right rail probe has only 49.904 mm local wood at two seat bolts, bores leave the rail, and tool access meets a panel. These are pose failures, not family verdicts. See hardware_first_hl33_common_core.md and hardware_first_hl53_spaced_ribs.md.
latest_hl_revisions: The independent-bolt HL33 backing revision removes the shared three-wood stack and meets nominal 88.9-mm receiving thickness but still rejects on nut/tool blockage and an unverified one-piece blank; six rail connections remain open. HL53 wide-rib 620/660-mm cases clear sampled header-link clashes; 700 mm hits a protected screw. At 660 mm, one bottom-right rail HL53 with 15-mm gap has 15 mm unsupported seat; a zero-gap isolated probe has full nominal seat contact, four contained bores and all 66 screw receivers but has not been integrated with parent neighbors or other five rails. A sampled 125.868-mm square cross-section fits a listed Lowe's 6x6 Douglas-fir blank dimensionally, not as delivered/accepted stock. See hardware_first_hl33_backing_revision.md, hardware_first_hl53_wide_ribs.md and hl-action-coverage-preliminary.md. No architecture selected, rated joint, or drilling release.
latest_br904_drawing_screen: Lowe's exact-model Adamax BR904 listing links a dimensioned image with rounded nominal width, leg lengths, thickness, hole diameters and hole centers. This corrects the earlier negative online-drawing search. It lacks controlled tolerance, bend-tangent datums, formed-steel resistance and wood-joint rating. Earlier BR904 fixed-frame hypothetical coordinates are superseded for nominal geometry. See br904-lowes-drawing-followup.md.
latest_rear_and_raised_center_screens: One rear-Y B66 center arrangement and three drawing-based BR904 raised-seat rows are rejected on nominal installed geometry. The B66 upper bores leave sloping principal wood and changed members intersect adjacent wood. The BR904 lower-post bore modeling error was corrected; the three actual rejections are inward-seat/principal interference and conservative wood edge/end search margins. Both screens preserve all 66 panel/kicker screw receivers. Neither tests all possible factory-bracket poses or establishes resistance. See hardware_first_b66_rear_y.md and hardware_first_br904_raised_seat.md.
latest_outward_and_front_center_screens: The drawing-based outward BR904 upper seats clear nominal plate, bolt-path, panel and screw collisions, but two principal rows miss the conservative reversible 4D-plus-hole-play edge marker by up to 43.650 mm; the lower post and rail connections are outside this one-pose study. The front-Y B66 center pose directly intersects fixed panels and protected screws and has upper bore receiving deficits. Neither is an all-family verdict or resistance claim. See hardware_first_br904_outward_seat.md and hardware_first_b66_front_y.md.
latest_deep_principal_upper_screen: A one-piece 60-mm rearward deepening of each principal clears nominal upper outward BR904 plate, bore, panel, screw and adjacent-member contacts while retaining all 66 screw receivers. The principal edge and header shoulder search reserves are only +2.313/+2.361 mm; these are neither tolerance-qualified nor formal NDS acceptance. A live Home Depot 4x10x12 #2 Premium Fir listing contains the sampled blank envelope dimensionally, but the listed 3.5-in thickness matches CAD exactly with no machining allowance, and local stock, delivered grade/species, yield and dimensions remain unverified. The lower center and six rail joints are absent. See hardware_first_br904_deep_principal.md.
latest_br904_reserve_screen: A follow-up 80-mm one-piece principal deepening and 242-mm raised-header half-width give nominal +17.634-mm principal transverse and +14.361-mm header shoulder search reserves, while the oblique-toe ray marker remains only +2.834 mm. No tolerance, complete center joint, or bolted-wood BR904 rating is established; preserve this as historical geometry evidence rather than active G1 selection. See hardware_first_br904_reserve.md.
gate_summary: G1 remains incomplete. The owner permits hidden-frame redesign but fixes the climbing surface, panels and all 66 panel/kicker screw axes, and requires prefabricated brackets without wood lap joints. Current work compares connected rated-HL architectures: HL33 common core plus bracket-connected front backing, and a coarse HL53 spaced-rib alternative. Existing HL/BR904/MiTek pose screens are historical constraints, not whole-family verdicts. The BR904 upper geometry reaches nominal wood-search reserve but still lacks an applicable bolted-wood bracket rating, lower joint, rail connections and tolerance basis. No architecture is selected; required actions, access, receiver support, local resistance, all six same-configuration native cases and final shop evidence remain open. No fabrication is released. See docs/bolted-candidate-rated-hardware-focus.md and docs/bolted-candidate-owner-inputs.json.
diagnostic_progress: Separate pre-gate kerf-right diagnostics now include five converged old-connector proxy cases and one converged left-center nominal AB205 topology case at three provisional stiffnesses. A bounded a12-forward left-center attempt did not converge and its forces are excluded. The remaining 22 stations retain proxy connectors; these are not LB-14 candidate solves, rated joint demands, G1/G2 closure, or drilling approval. See docs/bolted-candidate-center-design-convergence.md.
